purpose: Compare the existing platform's eleven CFN bindings with actual resource identities and references; no repair or deployment.

reads.target: Exact expected account, IAM user ARN and UserId; stop on mismatch.
Exact stackId only; record status, role ARN, parameter metadata, tags and outputs. No name fallback or alternate UUID.
Exact stackId, TemplateStage Original; hash actual body, compare with historical declaration, project the eleven resources and references. Do not render a replacement template.
Exact stackId, one page; record eleven logical/type/physical/status bindings; NextToken is incomplete evidence, not permission to paginate.
Once by exact fixed loadBalancer name; at most once by differing CFN physical ARN to establish whether the old binding exists. No account-wide list.
Once on the exact named platform ALB ARN returned above; at most once for a differing CFN HttpsListener physical ARN. One page, no other ALBs.
Once by exact fixed targetGroup name; at most once by differing CFN physical ARN. No discovery by VPC or account-wide list.
One batch, at most four existing ALB/TG ARNs resolved by the preceding exact reads; no tag-based discovery.
Exact fixed cluster, include TAGS; compare returned ARN with CFN Cluster binding.
Exact fixed cluster/service, include TAGS; compare service identity, task definition, counts, target group and network with CFN. Do not list tasks or fetch task ENIs.

Unique CFN physical and actual service taskDefinition ARNs only, fixed family/account/region, maximum two. Project identity, image, role ARNs, port/log/Secret version references and controller-disabled booleans; never save or print raw Environment/Command/Secret values.
One batch of at most four unique SG IDs resolved from the two CFN SG bindings and the exact platform ALB/service; compare VPC and 443/3000 relationships. No VPC inventory.

Only if CFN TaskIngress physical ID is an exact sgr-* ID: query that one ID. Otherwise record the physical-ID proof limit and compare the rule through the already returned SG permissions; do not enumerate rules.
Exact fixed logGroup as logGroupNamePrefix, limit 2, one page; retain only the exact name/ARN/retention/class, omit other groups. No log streams or events.
Exact fixed hostedZoneId; require sandbox.techlong.cloud. and public zone.
Exact fixed hostedZoneId, StartRecordName console.sandbox.techlong.cloud., StartRecordType A, MaxItems 5, one page; retain only exact A Alias. No API/buyer records or public resolver queries.

handling.credentialsOrUnknownApiError: Save sanitized error category and actual counts, stop; no automatic retry, refresh or second diagnostic call.
handling.stackAbsentDeletedOrDifferentUuid: Save exact result and stop; no stack-name fallback, repair or recreation.
handling.unexpectedResourceSetOrTemplate: Record differences and stop dependent traversal; no new object discovery, baseline overwrite or template normalization.
handling.exactResourceNotFound: Record absence as evidence, skip dependent reads, allow only remaining independent reads already listed; do not repeat the call.
handling.ambiguousIdentityOutOfScopeReferenceOrPa: Mark incomplete and stop that traversal; do not follow unrelated resources, pagination or unapproved requests.
handling.nextAfterCapture: Deliver one declaration/binding/runtime-reference difference table with actual request counts and observation times; any minimal repair or new read remains separately approved.

risks: Existing Source credentials are used in memory; network/provider audit logs and low nonzero API charges remain. Raw GetTemplate/DescribeTaskDefinition responses can enter CLI memory before allowlisted projection; do not fetch Secret values or private configuration.

Read-only calls are not a cross-service atomic snapshot. Resources can change concurrently; incomplete pages, exact missing objects and deliberate idle/controller-disabled differences must remain explicit, not be silently repaired or declared drift-free.

This inspection neither starts nor stops resources. Existing ALBs, storage and other retained resources may continue charging; 50 USD/month is a target, not a hard cap. No cleanup, automatic retries or rollback is installed.
